Definition
[$C^k$ spaces of sections (Definition K.6)] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0353 1. appk:K.6\group Function Spaces

For a bundle section $\phi $ with compatible connection, set $[\phi ]_j=\sup |\nabla ^j\phi |$ and $\| \phi \| _k=\sum _{j=0}^k[\phi ]_j$. The Banach space $C^k(\mathcal M,\mathcal E)$ consists of locally $C^k$ sections with finite $\| \cdot \| _k$ norm.
